rho_reference.binary_or_process: one ecbench binary (SHA-256 in each session.json), every arm a fresh process of it inside one session, same workloads and algorithm seeds
rho_reference.gae_band_basis: rung n = 27: ic is the group-law kernel arm (its counted unpriced native operations per run dominated by the kernel's pairs) and rho the rho.negation arm (its canonicalisations), each unpriced native operation priced at w GAE; means over the rung's targets and rounds; every other rung and arm is in summary.json
rho_reference.protocol: PS-6 (protocols/PS-6.md): matched strong rho on the same one-target workloads; on a random binary curve the automorphism group is {+-1}, so rho.negation is the strongest single-target rho the harness has for these curves (no Frobenius structure).
rho_reference.unit: S = group-addition equivalents / sqrt(r), cold, one target per run
